description: This file contains unit tests for utility functions related to tenant management, such as normalization, fetching session tenants, selecting tenants, and setting active tenants. It uses Jest for testing and mocks browser APIs like fetch and localStorage.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Normalizes various shapes of tenant identifiers to a string or null.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches tenant session data from the server and returns an array of tenants.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Selects a tenant by ID, posts the selection to the server, and updates localStorage.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Stores the active tenant ID in localStorage, replacing any legacy key.
